name: Redis Runtime Cache
description: Redis-backed runtime cache for QwenPaw agents. It lets agents, skills, and plugins keep short-lived execution state outside the LLM context and local files, with TTL, namespace isolation, sensitive-field masking, and lightweight stream support.
author: Felix MA

tools.name: redis_state_set
tools.description: Store short-lived agent runtime state outside the LLM context and local files. Use it for temporary API state, session data, workflow checkpoints, or plugin handoff payloads. Values are stored in Redis with TTL and namespace isolation. Configure Redis here once; every redis_state_* and redis_stream_* tool shares this configuration.

config_fields.name: redis_url
config_fields.label: Redis URL
config_fields.help: Shared Redis connection URL used by all Redis Runtime Cache tools.

config_fields.name: key_prefix
config_fields.label: Redis Key Prefix
config_fields.help: Prefix for keys created by this plugin, for example qwenpaw:runtime:...

config_fields.name: default_ttl_seconds
config_fields.label: Default TTL Seconds
config_fields.help: Default lifetime for cached runtime state when ttl_seconds is omitted.

config_fields.name: max_ttl_seconds
config_fields.label: Max TTL Seconds
config_fields.help: Upper bound for ttl_seconds, used to avoid accidental long-lived temporary state.

config_fields.name: max_value_bytes
config_fields.label: Max Value Bytes
config_fields.help: Maximum serialized JSON payload size accepted by redis_state_set.

tools.name: redis_state_get
tools.description: Retrieve previously stored agent runtime state from Redis without keeping the value in conversation context or local files. Sensitive fields are masked by default. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_delete
tools.description: Delete temporary agent runtime state when a skill, plugin, or workflow step no longer needs it. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_exists
tools.description: Check whether reusable runtime state already exists before deciding whether to re-run an external API call or tool step. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_state_ttl
tools.description: Inspect the remaining lifetime of cached runtime state to decide whether it should be reused or refreshed. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_add
tools.description: Append a lightweight runtime event for async workflows, plugin-to-plugin coordination, approval handoff, or subagent task handoff. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_read
tools.description: Read recent runtime events for inspection or simple polling. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_group_create
tools.description: Create a consumer group for reliable runtime event processing by multiple agents or workers. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_read_group
tools.description: Read runtime events as a named consumer in a group, suitable for distributed agent or task processing. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.

tools.name: redis_stream_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge processed runtime events after a workflow step completes successfully. Uses redis_state_set shared configuration.
